lines: Atlassian CEO Mike Cannon-Brookes argues AI will restructure jobs rather than eliminate them, comparing it to how digital banking changed what bank branches do instead of making them obsolete; the real risk is being outcompeted by people who use AI well.
He contends that as LLMs commoditize, the competitive edge shifts to the 'harness': the application layer, interface and enterprise context that turn model output into business outcomes.
Cannon-Brookes pitches Atlassian's 'teamwork graph', which pulls together knowledge, communication, project data and source code, as the context that lets agents deliver better results at lower cost.

He calls 'headless', command-line-only enterprise software counterproductive and says AI work must move past chat toward delegation (agents acting for users) and pairing (agents working alongside humans).
In his view, the lag in realized AI productivity gains is a design and UX failure in how agents are embedded in daily work, not a shortfall in model capability.
title: How Humans Will Work Alongside AI Agents — With Mike Cannon-Brookes
